THE PERIOD FIGURES ARE INDEPENDENTLY CONFIRMED BY DIFFERENCING THE TWO COVERS: 36,199.94 - 34,199.94 (the Pre-Election cover, 24232) = 2,000.00 EXACTLY, and 35,523.63 - 28,595.91 = 6,927.72 EXACTLY. So the rows are right and the ledger is complete FOR ITS PERIOD; what is unresolved is which grain the itemized layer publishes. Both figures are named, no sum is claimed, and the transcription is PARKED in _meta_itemized.withheld_rows so the owner's ruling can be applied without re-reading the page.
